Roots

IT STARTS WITH FARMING AND GENETICS

INFUSED begins in the field: genetics, biomass quality, farm technology and equipment that moves supply at scale.

Outdoor farming

Field production, biomass, irrigation, agronomy and crop quality.

Genetics + breeding

Variety selection, seed stock, clone programs and trait development.

Specialized tractors

Harvesters, tractors, trailers, field implements and farm automation.

Grow inputs

Soil, nutrients, pest management, irrigation and environmental monitoring.

“Roots” is not a side category — it is where everything starts.

Science + Manufacturing

SCIENCE TURNS PLANTS INTO PRODUCTS

Extraction, ingredients, formulation and manufacturing partners help brands create consistent, scalable, shelf-ready infused products.

Extraction + refinement

Distillate, isolates, minor cannabinoids and terpenes.

Ingredients + formulation

Flavors, emulsions, sweeteners and functional botanicals.

Production + co-packing

Dosing, mixing, bottling and private label.

Testing + quality

Potency, stability, compliance and shelf-life.

Packaging + Labeling

THE CORNERSTONE OF COMPLIANCE

Packaging, labeling, compliance and retail integration — the companies that ensure product integrity and make retail execution easier.

Packaging

Cans, bottles, pouches, jars, cartons, child-resistant formats and display-ready packaging.

Labeling

Compliance, QR codes, batch IDs, warning statements and claims support.

Retail technology

POS, payments, inventory, menu boards, merchandising and category management.

Compliance support

Regulatory review, testing docs, licensing support, SOPs and market-readiness.

Distribution
